about: HELD WITHHOLDS AT THE MEMBER DOOR (coordinator rulings 2026-11-19, part B): each narrow withhold removes exactly its element, by name, on the door that drew it; the measuring suites and the regrade see through the list. Every condition, broken once, must turn its rail red.

mutants.mutant: the runtime door draws a row withheld by title
mutants.from: if (o.title && heldRunOut.has(o.title)) { withheld.push({ label, why: heldWithholdSentence(heldRunOut.get(o.title)), o }); continue }
mutants.to: if (o.title && heldRunOut.has(o.title) && false) { withheld.push({ label, why: heldWithholdSentence(heldRunOut.get(o.title)), o }); continue }
mutants.expectRed: a row by title is withheld

mutants.mutant: the runtime door draws a withheld colour
the runtime door draws a withheld paint
mutants.from: if (heldPaint) { paintWithheld.push({ p, why: heldWithholdSentence(heldPaint) }); return }
mutants.to: if (heldPaint && false) { paintWithheld.push({ p, why: heldWithholdSentence(heldPaint) }); return }
mutants.expectRed: a paint by kind and line

mutants.mutant: the runtime door draws a withheld drawing family from its own run
mutants.expectRed: a drawing family is withheld: no drawings

mutants.mutant: the host door draws a withheld drawing family
mutants.expectRed: a drawing family is withheld, named, and the plots stay

mutants.mutant: the host door ignores a withhold it cannot hold back alone
a withhold is honoured on the door that did not draw the element
the regrade cannot see through the list
mutants.expectRed: the document exactly as the engine draws it
